entities.name: Southern Court
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Southern Court, a political institution in Japan during Muromachi and Sengoku Periods (1336–1467). Led to the emergence of Ashikaga Yoshimitsu builds the Golden Pavilion (Kinkaku-ji) in Kyoto and Ōnin War devastates Kyoto and begins the Sengoku 'Warring States' period.
